name: airllm
one_liner: Lets you run huge AI language models, the kind that normally need an expensive multi-GPU server, on a single cheap consumer graphics card by streaming the model in piece by piece.
buyer: A solo AI developer or small startup that wants to self-host a large, capable open-source model for a product without paying for expensive cloud GPU time or per-token API fees.
business_use_cases: A startup self-hosts a large open-source model on modest hardware to offer an AI feature without ongoing per-token API costs.
A privacy-focused business, such as a legal or healthcare practice, runs a large model fully on-premises on affordable hardware instead of sending client data to a cloud API.
A hobbyist developer prototypes with frontier-scale open models on a home GPU before deciding whether to pay for cloud infrastructure.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'cheap self-hosted AI' setup-and-support service for small businesses that want to run big models on affordable hardware.
Offer a managed hosting tier that runs this stack on rented single-GPU instances, billed per hour of usage.

steal_this: A weekend 'bring your own GPU' hosting side-business: rent out spare GPU capacity running large open models via AirLLM, billed by usage, for developers who can't afford cloud API costs.
